West Indies Stun India by Five Wickets in Third ODI

The West Indies defeated India by five wickets in the third ODI, successfully chasing down India's total of 352. Shai Hope scored an unbeaten 162, which overshadowed KL Rahul's century of 129 runs. Rohit Sharma also contributed 92 runs for India. The match took place at the New PCA Stadium.
